groundRules: One playthrough is enough. 55 trophies, all offline, no online trophies, no DLC needed. [1] [6]
No difficulty setting. There is nothing to pick — the same difficulty for everyone. [1] [6]
No New Game+ and no mission replay. Once a mission is done it cannot be replayed, so keep manual saves. [1] [6]
Cheats switch trophies off — and saving too. Keep them off for the whole run. [1] [6]
15 manual save slots plus 1 autosave. PowerPyx advises a save at the start and end of each chapter (10 saves), then rotating the other 5 during free-roam cleanup. [1]
The Irredeemable criminal profile is permanent. Avoid it — police turn far more aggressive. [1]
Platinum time is disputed: about 200 hours per PowerPyx, GTABase and KeenGamer — 300+ hours per Push Square. Plan for 200, budget 300. [1] [2] [6]
howBuilt: The stage order follows PowerPyx's three steps (story 60–80h, 100% checklist ~100h, strangers and cleanup 10–20h), split into six named stages so each stage fits on one screen. [1]

Every trophy is placed in the stage where its work is done, not where it pops: story trophies in Stage 1, checklist work in Stage 2, stranger questlines in Stage 3, partner crime in Stage 4, money in Stage 5, leftovers in Stage 6. [1] [12]
Earned counts per stage are counted live from your own checklist — the numbers move as you tick trophies off. [1]

Where guides disagree — platinum hours, chapter mapping, range counts, strand counts, stunt counts, meditation counts, two unconfirmed methods — both versions are shown in the Missables tab with a safe play, instead of picking one side quietly. [1] [2] [3] [13] [14]

Counts come from the official descriptions and the trackers that publish them (Exophase, PSNProfiles); methods come from the guides that show their work (PowerPyx first, Push Square, KeenGamer, GTABase). [4] [5]

stages.name: Story run — play it through
stages.text: Finish all five chapters and take the side content as it shows up. Every story trophy pops on its own. Do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation the morning after Down to Earth — it is the one thing that can pass you by. Scan vehicles and study animals as you go; the progress already counts toward the 100% checklist.

stages.name: The 100% checklist
stages.text: After the credits, open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion and work the list: 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, 70 of 80 challenges, every robbery, bank vault and gang operation, all underwater finds, shooting ranges and drone races, and all of Bret's target decks. The list is closer to 60% true completion — most of it is partial credit.

stages.name: Strangers & side quests
stages.text: Finish the stranger questlines: Andy (Lucia only), Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone (Jason only), plus Bret's hunts. Only eight stranger strands count toward the silver, and the four that are confirmed are Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete — the rest are shown in the disagreement panel.

stages.name: Crime with your partner
stages.text: The partner trophies all unlock once both characters can free-roam together after Coffee Break in Chapter 2: lose a 4-star wanted level together, rob three shops in a row, five bank vaults, an armoured truck, a jewellery store unseen, one illegal operation per gang, and the bowling-alley valuables.

stages.name: Money, garages & wheels
stages.text: Launder $250,000 in marked bills through fences, spend $100,000 across shops, buy all eight garages for $160,000 through the Vice City Real Estate app, and register ten vehicles with Scooter Bros. Robberies late in the story are the fastest money.

stages.name: Platinum sweep
stages.text: Mop up whatever is left: the cocktail on Ocean Beach, max strength with both characters, the 500 criminal-profile actions, the UFO easter egg, and the bike kicks. The one trophy with no confirmed method yet is Bad Luck, I Guess — its panel says what is actually known, and nothing is guessed.
